title: Phil’s First U-Bahn
author: phil_the
rules:
solve in Penpa+

Normal U-Bahn rules apply

Draw a single orthogonally connected loop network through the centres of some cells in the grid. The loop may branch and may cross itself but may have no dead ends.

Clues outside the grid give the number of intersections, branches, straight lines or corners in that row or column.
solutionCode: total number of cells visited by the loop
